Taylor: final RN draft up, target deploy 2024-10-01 15:00 UTC. link: https://docs.internal/rn/infer-v2.5
Jordan: quick question are we pinning model tag v2.5.0-canary for the first 12h?
Taylor: yes pin v2.5.0-canary. Canary: 7% traffic, 12h. auto-promote to v2.5.0 after pass.
Marta: rollback criteria suggestion: sustained 5xx >=3% over 5m OR p95 latency >2.5s for 2 consecutive 5m buckets. Also need rollback owner.
Taylor: assign Lee as rollback owner for first 6h. Lee: I got it. rollback command below:
```
infractl rollback --svc inference --to-tag v2.4.8 --note "canary-fail"
```
opsbot: Deploy scheduled: 2024-10-01T15:00:00Z. Canary config: 7% for 12h. Fallback target: v2.4.8.
Jordan: internal announce at T-10m in #eng-releases and #oncall; customer-facing T+2h if success. Embargo set.
Marta: I'll update RN ops snippet and paste final version in 8m.
Lee: I'll stand by oncall. If I trigger rollback, I'll open incident channel and run post-rollback checklist. :phone:
Taylor: thanks team. Jordan go ahead with internal announce 10m prior. Pin this thread in RN folder. :thumbsup:
